messages:
nell: Quick sync 	10m	 - Helix Hardware + Integrator (BrightPath) onboarding to CloudMall next week. We need a compact partner SEV path, plus who owns the private war-room channel and the post-launch drill.

rahul: I can own the war-room during launch window. Suggest channel name: #partners-helix-sev-private. Make it private, invite BrightPath L2 only after initial triage.

tara (pm): +1 on private channel. We need explicit run roles: bridge-runner, partner-liaison, rollback-owner, and comms-owner. Also confirm escalation thresholds so BrightPath knows when Redwood will execute rollback.

leo-partner: BrightPath L2 contact is me (leo). I'll be on-call first day. Phone: +1-555-901-2200. Zoom for fast-bridge: https://zoom.us/j/9988776655. Please add BrightPath escalation policy to channel.

ops-bot: Suggested template for channel creation: pinned: runbook.md, contact_card.md, rollback_checklist.md. Auto-subscribe: marketplace-ops, infra-oncall, partner-success.

partner-bot: Creating escalation tags: `[P-SEV1]`, `[P-SEV2]`, `[P-SEV3]` to prefix thread titles. Also add auto-snooze for non-action after 30m.

rahul: Draft runbook snippet (copyable):
```
P-SEV1: immediate war-room -> @bridge-runner -> add infra-oncall + BrightPath L2 -> 0-15m triage -> exec rollback if blocking and rollback-owner approves at T+30m
P-SEV2: async channel notify -> partner-liaison informs PMs -> monitor 4h
P-SEV3: log-only, follow-up next business day
```

tara: For legal/PR: any SEV1 customer-impacting incident triggers PR notify (internal list) within 45m. Partner comms-owner drafts joint customer message within 90m.

nell: Who's rollback-owner? Marketplace-ops oncall or BrightPath? Need decision now. If BrightPath approves remote rollback we need signed rollback authority doc.

leo-partner: BrightPath can approve and execute rollback for partner-owned integrations, but Redwood marketplace-ops must coordinate actual listing rollback. We'll sign the rollback authority on the integration contract addendum.

rahul: OK marketplace-ops oncall will be rollback executor; BrightPath L2 can recommend. I'll add step-by-step rollback commands to pinned rollback_checklist.md.

tara: We should also define postmortem owners: if it's partner-code bug -> BrightPath leads postmortem with Redwood as co-owner. If it's infra/listing issue -> Redwood leads. Add tags to postmortem template.

ops-bot: Channel created: #partners-helix-sev-private (private). Pinned: runbook.md, rollback_checklist.md, contact_card.md, postmortem-template.md. Invited: nell, rahul, tara, leo-partner, marketplace-ops-bot.

partner-bot: Auto-join rules set: marketplace-ops, infra-oncall, partner-success. Incident webhooks enabled.

nell: Good. Plan a 15min tabletop tomorrow 11:00 PT in the channel. Quick drill: escalate to P-SEV1, run rollback checklist, confirm customer comm draft. Everyone ok?

leo-partner: Confirmed. I'll have BrightPath L2 on call for drill.

rahul: I'll run the drill and time checkpoints. We'll capture timestamps for postmortem.

tara: I'll prepare comm templates (internal and customer-facing) and attach to pinned contact_card.md.

nell: Final items: 1) signed rollback authority from BrightPath to be uploaded to contact_card.md before Friday; 2) PR notify list synced; 3) marketplace rollback test in staging tomorrow at 09:30 PT.

leo-partner: Uploading signed doc now. See pinned contact card.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: tabletop drill in #partners-helix-sev-private at 11:00 PT tomorrow.

nell: Thanks all  :rocket:
